title: "building heights analysis"

date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.extras)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(plotly)
library(here)
library(httr)


# load data that has the dates the historic districts were designated
# comes from here: https://planning.dc.gov/page/dc-historic-districts
hd_data <- readr::read_csv("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Ajl1iAS0NRB7vk_UFDveeWzGkwf3tuiDo-zV9_wtzRM/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&sheet=data", show_col_types = F)

hd_shp <- st_read("https://maps2.dcgis.dc.gov/dcgis/rest/services/DCGIS_DATA/Historic_WebMercator/MapServer/6/query?outFields=*&where=1%3D1&f=geojson")

# Merge historic district (HD) data onto HD shapefile, subset to only look at neighborhood HDs:
hd_shp <- dplyr::left_join(x = hd_shp, y = hd_data, by = "UNIQUEID")
hd_shp <- hd_shp %>% filter(Neighborhood_HD==1)
```
